title: Privacy-first telemetry and reasoning-safe OpenAI-compatible output
highlights: Anonymous usage telemetry is now opt-in and ships disabled by default, so regulated and government deployments send nothing until an explicit `jcode telemetry enable` or `/telemetry` choice

DeepSeek-style inline reasoning markers are split out of visible text, so models served by Bailian/DashScope show their thinking in the reasoning area and the auth-test tool loop no longer misreports valid credentials
improvements: Inline  thinking/ response markers are routed to the reasoning channel across streaming chunk boundaries
OpenAI-compatible provider smoke compares only the answer after a leaked reasoning marker
fixes: Telemetry opt-out events are only sent when telemetry was actually enabled
Issue closure is skipped gracefully on repositories with Issues disabled
